summary: Backend-only regression verification for Windows offline startup packaging passed. Confirmed colorama runtime dependency/wheels, improved startup error surfacing, installer/download size parity, and portable MongoDB packaging with health endpoint availability.
action_items: Run one manual smoke on a real Windows machine to validate BAT/HTA runtime UX end-to-end (Linux container cannot execute native .bat/.hta startup path).
critical_code_review_comments: No blocking defects found in requested Windows offline startup scope.
server.py remains very large (>700 lines), increasing long-term maintenance/regression risk.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified /app/backend/requirements-runtime.txt and /app/release/BankDepositSystem/backend/requirements-runtime.txt both contain colorama==0.4.6. Confirmed colorama wheel exists in both wheels directories and release wheels count is 31 (backend wheels count also 31). Confirmed start_system_worker.bat writes 'Requirements installation failed. Last startup log lines:' and appends tail of startup.log into startup_error.txt on pip failure. Dist installer size is exactly 39983826 bytes, /api/download/setup returns HTTP 200 with 39983826 bytes, and /api/health returns {status: ok, service: bank-deposit-system}. Portable MongoDB binary exists at /app/release/BankDepositSystem/mongodb/bin/mongod.exe (38873088 bytes).
rca of the issue: Root cause from prior RCA (missing Windows-only colorama in offline wheel bundle) is now validated as mitigated: runtime requirements include colorama and matching wheel is bundled in release. Additional resilience check confirmed startup_error.txt now includes last startup.log lines when pip install fails, improving diagnosability.
